images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Management sim seen from a straight top-down bird's-eye camera over a small rainy city at dusk: dark wet asphalt streets reflecting warm sodium streetlamps and small neon shop signs, slate rooftops with AC units and glowing skylights, a river along the top edge crossed by two bridges, a park with dark tree canopies. Hundreds of tiny top-down umbrellas drift along the sidewalks; the player's rental umbrellas are all bright yellow with a soft glow, private umbrellas are red, blue, teal and white. A transit-map overlay sits on the city: a green line and an orange line with white station circles, each station tagged with a dark label chip showing a segmented yellow rack gauge, e.g. '시청앞 4/24'. A small yellow cargo bike travels along the green line labeled '우산 +10'. Right side panel: hourly rain forecast bars '오늘 밤 강수 예보' with 60% and 70% columns, a station list with rack bars, and a yellow button '자전거 배송'. Top HUD: '우산 대여점', amber clock '18:42'. Light drizzle streaks and splash rings, cinematic rainy-night palette of teal, navy and warm amber, fine film grain, soft vignette. Correction: strictly straight-down 90° top-down camera (no oblique angle, no building facades visible). Use only fictional station names, e.g. '시계탑앞 4/24', '다리목', '장터', '물레방아', '분수광장', '새벽시장'; no real place names (no 시청/광화문/남대문/명동/을지로/한강 or Sungnyemun gate) and no calendar date or year anywhere — the top HUD shows only '18:42'.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same top-down rainy city minutes into a sudden cloudburst: the scene is darker and bluer, heavy slanted rain streaks cover everything, dense splash rings on the asphalt, a faint lightning flash brightening one side. Dozens of people without umbrellas, seen as tiny heads and shoulders in muted coats, stream from every street toward one transfer station and crowd around it inside a pulsing dashed red ring; the station label chip shows an empty red rack '0/24' and '대기 34'. Only a few yellow rental umbrellas remain scattered on the map. A red banner at the top of the map reads '소나기 러시'. Right panel: the hourly forecast card showing a tiny 10% bar under a red rubber stamp '예보 빗나감', a dark red rush card with big numbers '대기 인파 34' and '0/24' and a yellow button '긴급 배분', and a cream lined paper note taped at an angle with a handwritten line about a yellow umbrella not returned for 41 days, 'No.0417'. Palette of storm navy, alarm red and umbrella yellow, film grain, heavy vignette, tense but tender mood. Correction: the crowded station is the fictional '시계탑앞' station; no real city, district or government names anywhere (no 서울, 중구, 서울특별시, 시청역), and no calendar dates.
